newsitem.title: UK: Wickes appoints head of audit committee.
newsitem.headline: Wickes appoints head of audit committee.

text.p: Wickes Plc, the do-it-yourself retailer currently embroiled in an internal investigation into accounting irregularities, has appointed John Napier as chairman of its audit committee.
Napier was senior partner at Touche Ross and Co until 1989 and recently retired from retailer W H Smith Group Plc where he was finance director and director of the home improvmeent unit Do It All.
Wickes' announced it had uncovered "deliberately misleading" accounting discrepencies in the summer which will result in a major restating of profits later this summer.
The errors going back five years are expected to wipe 50 million stg off restated profits once the internal investigation announces its findings.
